svg.aria-label: Dual-hub topology: a Transit Gateway and inspection VPC with Network Firewall in each Region, RAM-shared to dev and prod spokes, hubs joined by Transit Gateway peering
svg.font-family: Manrope, Open Sans, Segoe UI, sans-serif
svg.title: Dual-hub topology across Sydney and Auckland
svg.desc: Two Regions side by side. Each Region holds a hub account with a Transit Gateway and an inspection VPC containing Network Firewall and its firewall endpoint. Below the hub, a dev workload account and a prod workload account each own a spoke VPC with a demo host, attached to the hub Transit Gateway through a RAM share. The two hub Transit Gateways are joined by Transit Gateway peering, with ASN 65001 in Sydney and 65002 in Auckland.
